title: Gluten-Free Fried Italian Fritters
description: A tasty and crispy gluten-free Italian fritter recipe, perfect for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the gluten-free flour, Italian seasoning, and breadcrumbs.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and mix with the mozzarella cheese.
Add the diced tomato to the egg mixture and stir well.
Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy!
Optional: You can also bake the fritters in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
